name: Two "corrections" in PR #310 moved scores off the vendor table
symptom: Recorded scores drifted from the vendor table between passes: qwen3-6-35b-a3b SWE-bench Verified 73.4 -> 76.0 and GPQA 86.0 -> 86.7; qwen3-5-122b-a10b LiveCodeBench v6 75.5/75.6 -> 78.9.
root_cause: A 'correction' pass edited values that were already correct. The vendor cards render results as multi-column HTML tables; reading cells without first binding the per-table header shifts every value onto the wrong model column (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B is the last of five columns).
workaround: Parse each <table> separately, read its own header row, and bind values to column names before recording. Never align cells against a header from a different table on the same page.
notes: Re-verified 2026-10-19 by fetching both raw READMEs and reading the named column: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B = 73.4 SWE-bench Verified / 86.0 GPQA; Qwen3.5-122B-A10B = 72.0 SWE-bench Verified / 78.9 LiveCodeBench v6.
